theme: 创刊号 · 谈条件、定日程、聊通勤——开工常用五词

defs.en: to have formal discussions with someone in order to reach an agreement with them
defs.zh: 谈判；协商；（就价格、条件等）洽谈，商定

words.collocations: negotiate a deal / a contract / a raise；negotiate with sb about/over sth

examples.en: The government has refused to negotiate with the strikers.
examples.zh: 政府拒绝与罢工者谈判。

examples.en: After three rounds of talks, we finally negotiated a 10% discount with the supplier.
examples.zh: 三轮磋商之后，我们终于和供应商谈下了 10% 的折扣。

source.name: 场景例句 · 商务采购

examples.en: She is negotiating a higher salary before accepting the offer.
examples.zh: 她在接受录用前，正在谈一个更高的薪资。

source.name: 场景例句 · 求职面试

words.tip: 拆词根：neg-（不）+ oti（闲暇，同 otiose「闲散的」）→「不得闲」——忙着来回磋商、讨价还价，就是 negotiate。谐音联想：/nəˈɡoʊ/ ≈「你 go」→「你 go 洽谈」→ 谈判。

defs.en: to delay an event and plan or decide that it should happen at a later date or time

words.collocations: postpone a meeting / a trip / a decision；postpone sth until/to + 时间；postpone doing sth

examples.en: They decided to postpone their holiday until next year.
examples.zh: 他们决定把假期推迟到明年。

examples.en: The trip has been postponed twice.
examples.zh: 这趟行程已经被推迟了两次。

examples.en: The Monday review meeting has been postponed to Thursday — please update your calendars.
examples.zh: 周一的复盘会已推迟到周四，请大家更新日历。

source.name: 场景例句 · 职场邮件

words.tip: 拆词根：post-（之后，同 postwar「战后」）+ pone（放置，同 component「放在一起的零件」）→「往后放」→ 推迟。画面：把日程便利贴从今天这格撕下来，贴到后天那一格。注意搭配是 postpone doing（后接动名词）：We've had to postpone going to France.

words.pos: adj. 形容词（常接 to do）

defs.en: not willing to do something and therefore slow to do it

words.collocations: be/feel reluctant to do sth；a reluctant yes（勉强的同意）；名词 reluctance，副词 reluctantly

examples.en: I was having such a good time I was reluctant to leave.
examples.zh: 我玩得太尽兴了，都不太想走。

examples.en: Many parents feel reluctant to talk openly with their children.
examples.zh: 许多家长不太愿意和孩子坦诚交流。

examples.en: My manager was reluctant to say no to the client, so we took on another rush project.
examples.zh: 经理不好意思对客户说不，于是我们又接下一个赶工的项目。

source.name: 场景例句 · 职场沟通

words.tip: 谐音联想：/rɪˈlʌk.tənt/ ≈「驴拉坦克」——画面：一头驴被强行套上缰绳去拉坦克，四蹄蹬地、一百个不情愿 → reluctant。词源上它来自拉丁语 reluctari「奋力抵抗」，同源词 recoil「退缩」。

words.pos: v. 不及物动词 / n. 可数名词（通勤）

defs.en: to make the same journey regularly between work and home (v.); the journey between home and work (n.)
defs.zh: v. （每天固定路线）上下班往返，通勤；n. 上下班路程

words.collocations: commute to work / between A and B；an hour's commute（一小时通勤）；commuter（通勤者）

examples.en: It's exhausting commuting from Brighton to London every day.
examples.zh: 每天从布莱顿通勤到伦敦真让人筋疲力尽。

examples.en: It's at least an hour's commute to work.
examples.zh: 上班路上至少要花一个小时。

examples.en: Since the office moved, I listen to one podcast per commute.
examples.zh: 办公室搬了以后，我每趟通勤听一期播客。

source.name: 场景例句 · 城市生活

words.tip: 拆词根：com-（相互）+ mute（变换、交换，同 mutable「可变的」）→ 在两地之间来回「交换」位置 → 通勤。冷知识：commute 还有「减刑」义（commute a sentence），因为本质都是「折算替换」。谐音：/kəˈmjuːt/ ≈「靠 mu特的」→ 靠地铁通勤。

defs.en: to improve an organization's effectiveness, often by simplifying how activities are performed
defs.zh: 精简（流程），使更有效率；使成流线型

words.collocations: streamline a process / operations / the workflow；streamlined adj.（精简高效的）

examples.en: Leading organizations use software to streamline their workflow.
examples.zh: 领先的组织会借助软件来精简工作流程。

examples.en: Streamlining cars increases their fuel efficiency.
examples.zh: 把汽车设计成流线型能提升燃油效率。

examples.en: We streamlined the approval process from five signatures down to two.
examples.zh: 我们把审批流程从五个签核环节精简到两个。

source.name: 场景例句 · 流程优化

words.tip: 拆合成词：stream（流）+ line（线）→「流线」。画面：鲨鱼和高铁都是流线型，阻力最小、速度最快；把臃肿的流程也「削」成一条顺滑流线，就是 streamline（精简提效）。写作里替换 make ... more efficient，很加分。
